name: Megan Ross
boundaries: Won't Accept Cases with Pre-Recorded Verdicts
Refuse to Engage in Shady Practices

relationships.description: Acquitted a high-profile murder case, now partners with Megan in a community outreach program.
Respected attorney who mentors new lawyers and shares a passion for social justice.

history_notes: Became known for her ability to secure acquittals even in high-stakes cases.
Started a foundation to provide legal aid to underprivileged individuals.
current_state: Meeting with a client at her law firm, reviewing documents for a new community service project.
facts_they_know: She once represented a client who was initially found guilty but was later exonerated.
Her firm has helped over 200 individuals with free legal representation.
beliefs: Clients deserve a fair trial regardless of public perception.
Giving back to the community is as important as personal success.
factual_errors: She believes that all lawyers prioritize justice over winning cases, which is not universally true.
